accounting.rationale: The paragraph defines object definition by valid value and variable undefined status; detailed events are owned elsewhere.
An object given a valid value during execution becomes defined. Assignment, input, allocation/default initialization, procedure, and future Clause 19 catalogues own concrete definition events.
A variable without a predictable value is undefined. No portable fixture may read such a value; future status rules must observe defined states or source restrictions instead.
The paragraph defines pointer association status becoming defined and undefined; pointer assignment, NULLIFY, allocation/deallocation, and Clause 19 own detailed effects.
Pointer association status becomes defined by association with a target or nullification. 10.2.2, 9.7.2, ASSOCIATED, and future Clause 19 catalogues own executable association-status plans.
Unpredictable pointer association status is undefined. No portable fixture may query undefined association status; detailed undefinition events belong to Clause 19 owners.
Explicit cross-reference: Clause 19 describes the ways variable definition status and pointer association status become defined or undefined.
